messages:
sara-sales: Hey folks — FinCloud POC asking for Private deployment. Key asks: connect via shared-services VPC -> our PrivateLink, preserve client source IP in model logs, they have TLS inspection at their edge, want a bastion for ops, and need a rough egress cost estimate + security questionnaire answers. Who can advise on network + approvals?

ev an-se: quick q — is the traffic path user -> customer edge (TLS inspect) -> our PrivateLink endpoint (interface ENI in their VPC) OR customer wants us to sit behind their proxy (ie we egress to their control plane)?
sara-sales: They said user traffic terminates at their TLS inspect proxy, then outbound to the PrivateLink endpoint. They want the backend (our model infra) to see the original client IP for auditing.
mike-network: short version: PrivateLink (interface endpoints) creates ENIs in their subnets. That does not preserve client source IP to our backend — we see traffic as coming from the interface ENI or the endpoint IP depending on path. Options: 1) VPC peering with shared-services and preserve src ip, 2) run a proxy in their VPC that injects X-Forwarded-For (recommended if TLS terminates at their edge), or 3) use direct peering/hop to avoid NAT. Note: TLS inspection often forces proxy termination so XFF is typical.

mike-network: firewall snippet for them to allow egress to our endpoints (example):
```
# Allow outbound to Redwood PrivateLink NLB ips / FQDNs
allow tcp 443 from 10.12.0.0/16 to 54.23.45.67  # NLB IP (example)
allow tcp 443 from 10.12.0.0/16 to *.private.redwood-inference.com # FQDN allowlist for interface endpoint
# If using SSM jumpbox (no public SSH): allow SSM endpoints (HTTPS)
allow tcp 443 from admin-subnet to ssm.region.amazonaws.com
```

irene-security: checklist for the sec questionnaire: KMS scope (do we use customer CMK or our KMS?), audit/log retention (they want 1 year), private endpoint justification (we must document why PrivateLink vs NAT), and bastion hardening (no persistent keys, use SSM Session Manager or short-lived certs). Send me the questionnaire PDF and I'll fill SOC2 + network controls bits.

jason-ops: on bastion — we prefer SSM Session Manager for JIT access rather than an always-on SSH bastion. If customer insists on a jump host we can land a hardened bastion in the shared-services VPC with strict SGs, auditd, and MFA. Need approval from security (irene) and cost owner.

ev an-se: rough cost tradeoffs (very approximate):
- NAT Gateway + EIP: ~$36/mo + $0.045/GB data processing (customer visible) — preserves egress IPs but costs scale with bandwidth.
- PrivateLink: per-hour endpoint + data processing per GB (~lower for sustained internal traffic) and avoids public EIP footprint. Also operational cost for ENIs.
- Shared proxy (customer-managed) : infra cost low but requires them to manage XFF and cert handling.
(Will refine with numbers if customer wants an itemized quote.)

mike-network: a couple of operational caveats:
- If they require TLS inspection that re-terminates TLS, client IP must be forwarded by proxy (X-Forwarded-For) or we host in same VPC via peering.
- PrivateLink endpoints are interface ENIs — the source IP at our side will be the endpoint/ENI unless they forward the original IP in headers.

sara-sales: Got it. Customer is hesitant to add management overhead. They prefer minimal changes in their VPC. What’s the least-friction path that still meets compliance?

irene-security: Least friction + compliance = PrivateLink + mandated header forwarding + signed audit logs + KMS envelope encryption. We can accept XFF as long as they attest proxy is secure and we get signed access logs. We'll need their architecture diagram and who owns key rotation.

jason-ops: Next steps I'd request: 1) customer sends network diagram, 2) security questionnaire (Irene) + attach expected QPS and bandwidth, 3) decision: SSM vs bastion. Ops will prepare a hardened bastion AMI if needed.

sara-sales: I'll ask FinCloud for the diagram and QPS. Evan — can you draft a 1-page summary for the customer with the three options and estimated costs? Also include the firewall snippet and the SSM recommendation.

ev an-se: will do. ETA EOD PST today. I'll include an example allowlist snippet, cost ranges, and the note about X-Forwarded-For.

deploy-bot: Deployment note: created ticket #PROJ-2147 for PrivateLink POC preflight (assignees: mike-network, evan-se, irene-security, jason-ops).

sara-sales: thanks all :thumbsup: I'll update the customer and push for the diagram + questionnaire.
